title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 MAY)
summary: A curated list of feature ideas and improvement suggestions submitted by the Business Central community for May 2026, covering areas including agents and Copilot, data migrations, financial management, inventory, warehousing, sales, purchasing, and localization enhancements.
key_points: Community members proposed configuration package defaults, timezone settings on Entra applications, and improved telemetry for database indexes
Financial management suggestions include VAT handling improvements, bank reconciliation enhancements, and new reporting capabilities for stock and aged receivables
Development-focused ideas cover page list visualization, SharePoint Graph functionality extensions, and AL debugging improvements
Multiple localization and regional requests including Belgium VAT corrections, Norwegian chart of accounts, and India TDS calculation threshold adjustments
Operational improvements suggested for inventory workflows, manufacturing unit of measure handling, and purchasing responsibility center tracking

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the purpose of the post as presenting community-driven improvement suggestions for the platform
